features.quote: Pre-define transcript signals that halt a run early regardless of turn budget — e.g. severe distress-saturated output, explicit requests to stop

features.quote: The `declare_impossible`/`give_up` tool is both better science... and the humane default
No gratuitous cruelty in framing. Neutral task framing only. Don't add insult, mockery
